title: Disable chart animations across all graph components

requirements.summary: Disable animations in CO2Chart by adding isAnimationActive={false} to all Recharts series components
acceptanceCriteria: All Line (and any other series) components in CO2Chart.tsx have isAnimationActive={false}
No animation plays when the CO2 chart renders or updates

file_operations.description: Add isAnimationActive={false} prop to all <Line> components (co2Right, co2Left, co2CSV series) to disable chart animations on render and update
